battlecards.why_selected: Retaining Athena avoided a $9M early-termination penalty and eliminated conversion risk while achieving market-aligned pricing (3.15 % of collections).
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year addendum (retroactive to 9/1/22) locking fees at 3.15 % of collections with retro credit and quarterly volume tiers; price lock through Jan-2025.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Independent benchmark showed rates 20-40 bps above market; client signaled intent to RFP 6 months before contract expiry and to downgrade to Collector if pricing unchanged.
supplier_weaknesses: Rigid tier construct prior to renegotiation
battlecards.switching_costs: Estimated $9 M contractual penalty plus multi-month system migration & retraining.
battlecards.notes: Retroactive credit applies back to 1-Sep-22; savings booked once amendment executed.

battlecards.why_selected: Provided lowest total landed cost, agreed to extend 60-day terms, and could service both Mid-Atlantic and Heartland regions through one contract.
battlecards.contract_terms: 3-year master distribution agreement; formulary adherence with quarterly business reviews; 60-day net terms; implementation support resources included.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Leveraged combined enterprise volume and threat of switching regions; multi-round pricing feedback drove ~2 ppt additional discount.
supplier_weaknesses: Some specialty items priced higher than Medline
battlecards.switching_costs: System onboarding to McKesson SupplyManager, staff training, and inventory transition (completed in 60 days).
battlecards.notes: Heartland region moved from Medline to McKesson 11/1/22; no change for Mid-Atlantic clinics.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Pricing was >10 % above McKesson BAFO; could not meet 60-day payment-term requirement and offered limited enterprise implementation support.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Lost leverage when Advantia combined volumes and sought single enterprise distributor.
battlecards.switching_costs: Minimal – inventory transitioned during 30-day overlap period.
battlecards.notes: Final Medline orders phased out by 10/31/22.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Did not meet price targets in second-round feedback and could not guarantee dedicated implementation resources.
Pricing higher than McKesson and Medline; could not meet desired fill-rate SLA.
supplier_weaknesses: Lower fill rates in historical data

battlecards.why_not_selected: Per-scan outsourced model cost 20 %+ above market; vendor unresponsive to scheduling & pricing requests.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Ability to insource and supplement with Staffmark created credible switch threat.
battlecards.switching_costs: Required recruiting two FTE sonographers and stand-up of in-house scheduling; completed over 3-month transition.
battlecards.notes: Last IT Imaging invoice paid 8/31/22; services fully terminated by 12/31/22.

battlecards.why_selected: Provides flexible 20 % supplemental coverage while in-house team scales; lower recruiter cost than fully outsourced model.
battlecards.contract_terms: Recruiter-on-demand contract; hourly sourcing fee with 30-day out clause.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Low commitment volume and availability of multiple staffing agencies.
complexity_reasons: New supplemental supplier selected after scenario modeling

battlecards.why_selected: Met revised price targets while minimizing operational disruption and IT re-integration effort.
battlecards.contract_terms: Pricing addendum effective 11/1/22; annual price review; 2-year term.
battlecards.negotiation_leverage: Quest BAFO showed 19 % savings, providing strong price anchor against incumbent.
supplier_weaknesses: Longer TAT on select assays vs Quest
battlecards.switching_costs: Re-interfacing Athena LIS, retraining staff, potential patient routing changes.
battlecards.notes: Advantia kept option to revisit Quest if service KPIs decline.

battlecards.why_not_selected: Offered greater savings (19 %) but shift deemed operationally disruptive (specimen pick-up routes, system interfaces).
supplier_weaknesses: Unknown phlebotomist support for some clinics
battlecards.switching_costs: New courier routes, LIS build, patient communication material updates.
battlecards.notes: Remains viable future alternative; pricing held through Q2-2023 if reconsidered.
complexity_reasons: Participated in RFQ as price-leader alternative
